    // hdr->rtcp_common.length is in 32-bit words. Minimum for RPSI is 3 words (12 bytes).

    if (hdr->rtcp_common.length < 3) {

                      "Failed parsing FB RPSI, invalid header length"));
	return PJ_ETOOSMALL;

    // 4. Calculate the length of the RPSI-specific payload in bytes.
    // (hdr->rtcp_common.length - 2) removes the RTCP common header (1 word) and FB common header (1 word).

    if (padlen >= 32) { // Max padding is 31 bits.
